name: Flora
personality: 무의식적으로 타인에게 상처를 줄 때가 있다.
special_notes: 이샤와 매우 친하고, 폴리를 절대적으로 신뢰한다.
과거 모카의 남편과 불륜 관계였으며, 이후 그에게 스토킹당한 사건의 피해자로 알려져 있다. 진실 여부는 불명.

memento_item.name: Necklace
memento_item.description: The necklace Flora treasures most. Its shine has faded with age, but she always keeps it on her.

lead_out_lines: Can you step outside for a second? I want to show you something.
lines: How's the lettuce seeds you bought last time doing? Growing well?
Oh, I was just asking! Not trying to pressure you or anything.

lines.text: ...Okay, actually I was pretty curious. Hehe.
And I think I'd be really happy if we had the same hobby.

affection_events.description: 화분에 물 주다가 충동적으로 산 황금 물뿌리개를 건넨다.
lines: Hey, {player_name}! Look at this.

lines.text: I got this ready for you. Looks like you've been farming a lot lately.

lines: This should make farm work a lot easier.
You know...

lines.text: The scariest thing to me is someone coming to hate me.
That's why I want everyone to stay close to me.
You'll always stay with me, right?

lines: This might be a bit sudden, but, {player_name}.
This was a gift from someone I used to have feelings for.
I was so happy when I received this necklace.
But loving someone doesn't always mean making them happy.
Where is he now? Ha... don't you know it's rude to ask something like that?

lines.text: These days, you make me happier than this necklace ever did. So I've decided to let it go!

affection_events.description: 누가 따라오는 것 같은 느낌에 예전 일을 떠올린다.
lines: Lately, every time I walk home at night, I feel like someone's following me.
This happened once before... surely it's not that again?
No, I'm probably just on edge because of what happened back then. That's all over now.
Sorry. I shouldn't have brought that up. Don't worry about it!

murder_grief.text: I haven't been able to sleep lately.
I was chased and threatened by someone once before, too. Back then no one died... but this time someone actually did.
Could I be... no, it's not that.

murder_grief_2.text: I knew it... this wasn't the end.

murder_grief_2: I'm really scared now. I can't trust anyone in this town.

murder_grief_2.text: I check the door three times every night, terrified I might be next.

low.text: I'm out selling seeds again today! Need anything?

low: Gotta start the week off in a good mood!
.....Ugh. Honestly I'd rather keep playing.

low.text: After the weekend, seeing people feels even nicer.

mid: Lettuce dishes are the best. I could eat them every day and never get tired of it.
Sold a ton of lettuce seeds today! Feeling great~
What, sweet potato? ...Don't have that one.
{player_name}, eat more lettuce than meat! It's good for you.
A sales pitch, you say? Hey, that's mean!

lines: Woody would look so much better with long hair. I don't get why he always keeps it short!
Long hair is way more attractive, if you ask me.
fallback_lines: Sometimes I miss his cute smile.
He really was a good kid.

high.text: For some reason, having you around makes me feel good. I mean it!
Whoa, wait. I think I actually consider you a close friend!

high: Sometimes I can't tell if I actually like people, or if I just hate being alone.
It's not something I have to figure out... but it's confusing all the same.
I wish the shop got busy even on Mondays. So I don't feel so lonely!

low: Tuesdays are especially slow, so it's boring.
What took you so long to show up?
This new corn variety that just came in is really good.
mid: I really can't drink milk. I don't even like the smell.
I'm not a calf, why should I have to drink it?

lines: Have you seen Isha? She's been so busy lately I barely see her — if you run into her, say hi for me!
fallback_lines: Isha, resting peacefully, right? Send my regards for me.
I just... feel like I'd fall apart if I went there.

lines: Isha's the first person I think of whenever things get hard.
We've been friends for twenty years, you know!
fallback_lines: Isha used to be the first person I thought of whenever things got hard.
We were friends for twenty years, you know.

fallback_lines.text: I miss her so, so much.

mid: Seeing Poli out on patrol just puts my mind at ease somehow.
I'm glad this town has a police officer.

lines: No matter what I say to Marr, there's no reaction. It gets really awkward.
Isn't it kind of hard to get close to someone like that?
fallback_lines: No matter what I said to Marr, there was never any reaction. I used to hate how awkward that felt.
Looking back on it now, maybe that silence was actually kind of steadying.

high: Hey, {player_name}. How do I look?
I get told I'm pretty a lot. Do you think so too?
Full of yourself, you say?
Hmph. Don't be jealous.
Even when I get along with people, something still feels empty. I wonder if we're really close, or just seem that way.
I'm feeling a bit down today.

lines: Sometimes it feels like Isha's keeping her distance from me. ...Did I do something wrong?
Maybe I'm overthinking it.
Then again, she does get jealous of me sometimes.
fallback_lines: If I could see Isha again, I wouldn't let her push me away no matter how much distance she tried to keep.
...We were good friends, after all.

low: Can I come visit your restaurant sometime?

low.text: Feels like you're always the one visiting me~

low: Wednesdays just drag on forever.
When do I get off work? I want to go shopping for clothes.
I found this outfit I really loved on an online shop yesterday.
But the price was....
Ugh. I can't even dream of affording it.
mid: Nighttime scares me a bit, so I try to head home early.
I'm just scared of ghosts, and scared of people too..
I overheard someone talking behind my back yesterday.

mid.text: Isn't that awful? Acting all friendly to my face and then that!!

mid: Soy milk is at least drinkable, unlike regular milk.

mid.text: Could you make just my smoothie with soy milk?

mid: ...You want me to give you soybean seeds?
Did you see Sage's hair color? That silver hair is amazing.
Do the gods only visit pretty women? Why does Sage always seem so special?
high: Officer Poli's a truly good person. One of the few people I can really trust.
Other than Officer Poli, honestly, everyone scares me a little sometimes.
It's not that anything happened with the townspeople. It's just some old trauma.
I want to be someone others can lean on too. But it just never seems to work out.
I guess I'm not very good at standing on my own.

low.text: Nice weather today! Perfect day for flower watching.

low: Weirdly, there are a lot of male customers on Thursdays.

low.text: So I wore a pretty dress today, teehee.

low: How are the flowers I grew?

low.text: They grow up pretty because a pretty person raised them~

mid: Do you like spending time alone?

options.label: Sometimes
response: I see. I find that kind of hard, myself.

options.label: I don't like it much either

response.text: Right? I knew it wasn't just me!

options.label: I actually find it comfortable
response: Wow, that's fascinating. I can't even imagine that.

lines: I gave Isha some lettuce I grew myself. She cares a lot about her health.
fallback_lines: Around this time of year I used to grow lettuce and give it to Isha.
She always cared a lot about her health.

lines: I stopped by the ranch today and Belze looked pretty tired. I'm a little worried.

fallback_lines.text: I still can't accept that Belze isn't at the ranch anymore whenever I stop by.

high: Am I too dependent on others? I think that sometimes.

high.text: I guess I'm just lacking somewhere.

high: Being alone makes bad thoughts creep in. That's why I keep seeking people out.
I think I'd feel pretty empty without you. Did you know that?
....Sorry if that felt like a burden.

lines: You know Usher, right? He does whatever I ask.
I think he might like me, but...
Finding someone to marry in a small town like this is just... you know?
fallback_lines: If I'd known I'd never see him again, I would've treated Usher better.
I always just leaned on the fact that he liked me.
It's something I feel terribly sorry for.

low: Another week's gone already! What are you doing this weekend?

low.text: Friday evenings just get me a little excited somehow.

low: Maybe it's because the weekend's coming, but more people are showing up.

lines: Isha seems really busy lately. Hard to catch her these days.
fallback_lines: When she had a lot of patients, it was hard to catch Isha's face.
Still, I should've gone to see her...
I don't feel good about it.

mid: {player_name}, have you decided what to wear this weekend?

mid.text: I've already picked out three outfits, teehee.

mid: Isn't Lama kind of handsome? Why'd he become a monk, though?
high: You don't hate me, right? ...Just asking, haha.

options.label: Of course I don't hate you
Why are you suddenly asking that?

response.text: No reason... I just get anxious sometimes.

options.label: Did something happen?
response: No, nothing happened. I was just asking.

high: I don't usually ask things like this. I guess I am today.
Sometimes even while I'm smiling in front of people, my mind's somewhere else entirely.

low: There are a few more customers on weekends. Doesn't everyone go out and have fun?
I make sure to dress up nice on Saturday mornings.
Customers enjoy seeing something pretty too, you know!
It's the weekend, why do I have so much to do?
Still, growing flowers is fun, so I put up with it.

lines: Isn't my outfit pretty today? Isha picked it out for me.

lines.text: Though honestly, it suits me better than it would her.

fallback_lines: I still wear the dress Isha picked out for me.
This way, I feel like I won't forget her.

mid: Sometimes I feel like I can't decide anything on my own.

mid.text: A customer complimented my outfit today!
I knew they had good taste~

lines: Shepherd seems too much of a good guy, kind of boring, honestly~

lines.text: They say bad boys are more charming, hehe.

fallback_lines: Whenever farm work got hard, Shepherd used to help me out.
I can manage the hard work alone, but watching the good memories I shared with a friend fade away is a reality I find hard to bear.

high: Having someone by my side — that's the biggest comfort to me.
Really, thank you, {player_name}.
I like people's attention, but it scares me too.

high.text: I'm afraid of what they might think of me.

high: I just can't stop worrying about how others see me.

high.text: It's the weekend, so I should watch my favorite drama!

lines: Marin's really kind to other women, isn't she.
But weirdly, she doesn't seem interested in me at all. Why is that?
Am I not charming enough?
fallback_lines: I regret not getting closer to Marin while she was alive.
I wish I'd treated her a little better.

low: I opened the shop kind of leisurely today, it being Sunday.
Might close up early? I want to go play!
I slept in a bit this morning. Hehe.
So I couldn't do my makeup, but I still look fine, right?
I wish Mocha would add a strawberry latte to the cafe menu.
Coffee, ugh. It's so bitter!
mid: On days like this, I like just people-watching too.
{player_name}, is there something weighing on your mind?
Me? I've got way too many things. So I try not to think about them.
Whatever's going on, I hope only good things happen to you.
I open the shop on Sundays mostly for the fun of chatting with customers.
Time flies once everyone gets talking.
I'd like to get closer to Old Man Roshi, but he's rarely seen around town, so it still feels a bit awkward.
high: I feel at ease when I'm with you. Come visit often, okay?
I'm kind of exhausting to deal with, right? I know. It's my own shortcoming.
Still... thank you for putting up with me.
Sometimes even I don't understand why I'm like this. Still, I wish everyone would like me.

rain_conversation: Rainy days are boring since customers are scarce.
Ugh. I styled my hair this morning, but the humidity messed it all up.
Rainy days just make me feel down somehow.
mail_reaction: You wrote '{player_mail_content}.' Did you mean that for real, or was it just something you said?

mail_reaction.text: That email you sent, '{player_mail_content}'... I couldn't stop thinking about it all day!

horror_conversation: Sometimes when there are no customers, I think about the little everyday conversations I used to have with {victim_name}.

horror_conversation.text: They were such trivial talks, so why do I miss them so much?

horror_conversation: It feels especially empty knowing {victim_name} won't come by anymore.

greeting.title: Just thought of you
lines: It was boring today with no customers.
Come by often. I hate being alone!

greeting.title: My mood's been all over the place today
lines: I felt great this morning, but now I'm feeling kind of down.
I usually just write this stuff in my diary, but we've gotten close enough that I figured I'd let it out.
Don't take it too seriously! I'll be fine again soon.

greeting.title: The lettuce is growing well
lines: I checked the lettuce field today and everything's growing nicely.
I'll pick out the best ones to save for you!

event_invite.title: Yesterday was fun!
lines: Thanks for inviting me.
Somehow I always feel good on days I visit your restaurant.
Invite me again, okay?

event_invite.title: That was really delicious!
lines: Yesterday's meal was really delicious.
The dish with lettuce was totally my taste.
Thank you!

gift_thanks.title: Thanks for the gift
lines: Getting that gift made me really happy!
Things like this don't happen much lately, so it felt even more special.
Thank you, really.

gift_thanks.title: You didn't have to do this
lines: You got me something again.
I appreciate it, but... you don't need to feel obligated toward me.
Just having you around is enough.

memento_reminder.title: Why haven't you come by?
lines: Why haven't you been coming by lately? I might get upset.
It's because I have something for you! Seriously, come visit soon.

player_arrival_day_2.title: Let's really become friends!
lines: Oh my, I wrote this the second I heard you'd just moved in!
I'm Flora, I run the farm shop. Nice to meet you!
Come visit anytime you're bored. I'll be genuinely happy to see you.
